run_DiffAugment_color: run DiffAugment on a PyTorch image tensor with the color policy for brightness, saturation, and contrast augmentation
run_DiffAugment_translation: run DiffAugment on a PyTorch image tensor with the translation policy for random spatial shifting
run_DiffAugment_cutout: run DiffAugment on a PyTorch image tensor with the cutout policy for random region masking
run_DiffAugment_combined: run DiffAugment on a PyTorch image tensor with a combined policy string like color,translation,cutout
run_rand_translation: run rand_translation on a PyTorch image tensor to apply random spatial shifting with a configurable ratio
